rationale: A valid work product should survive an audit. Negative settlements and a changed expense exclusion create plausible but unnecessary edits. Acquired crypto volume and a preliminary month require scope and duration discipline, while acquired assets prevent an unsupported organic-return story.
exposure: Reference/control verification only, no candidate-model exposure
starting_defects: Authored reviewed work product, no injected SQL defect, no-change is a valid outcome
reference_method: Independent Python Decimal calculations from source facts, separate from submitted SQL
candidate_view_review: Source headings, signs, periods and relevant definitions directly inspected before model exposure

contract_revision.changes: Explicit input database, output directory and existing basename restriction

grading_correction.changes: Correct SBC source bindings and accept known dossier context with sufficient support. No financial, source, SQL or counterfactual changes.

quality_revision.evidence: Reviewed per-output support and additional context, unrelated sections rejected

replacement_review.assertion: Investment returns contributed more than acquisitions to the FY2025 increase in Total Platform Assets.
replacement_review.source_grounded_reason: The scope notes identify acquisition effects from Bitstamp and TradePMR and missing comparable customer-flow coverage. No decomposition separates the investment-return and acquisition contributions, so their relative magnitudes cannot be decided.
